sentence: The NHS says pernicious anaemia is the most common cause of vitamin B12 deficiency in the UK.

Lack of B12 from the diet is uncommon, but it can happen with a vegan diet that includes no supplements or fortified foods.
Some medicines, including proton pump inhibitors and metformin, can reduce B12 levels.
The NHS notes that some medicines, including anticonvulsants, can affect how much of these vitamins the body absorbs.

sentence: B12 deficiency anaemia is usually treated with injections of vitamin B12, called hydroxocobalamin.
When the cause is diet, treatment may be daily B12 tablets instead.
Folate deficiency is usually treated with folic acid tablets.
Clinicians check B12 status first, because folic acid can mask a vitamin B12 deficiency.
Follow-up blood tests check that treatment is working.
